{{Top|leg}}
'''Stabmen''' were traditional [[styanax]] hunters of [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], most commonly on the [[Sea of Jarad]]. They hunted the styanax in traditional wide-hulled canoes called [[nagak]]s, which required a rowing crew of about a dozen in addition to between two and four stabmen with harpoons. Because of the necessity of stealth, a nagak did not use a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] or propeller engine. The styanax were clever hunters and also clever prey and could sense powered watercraft.

Once the stabmen had lanced a styanax with a harpoon or two, the styanax became enraged, and a massive struggle erupted between the creature and the hunters. A good crew could reel the creature in over the course of several minutes; however, a powerful styanax was capable of overturning a nagak.
